preconditions.description: The number of operations n must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t_i <= 3 for t_i in operations)
preconditions.description: Each operation type t_i must be 1, 2, or 3.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= len(sequence) for a_i in operations if t_i == 1)
preconditions.description: For type 1 operations, a_i must be at least 1 and not exceed the current length of the sequence.

preconditions.expression: all(-1000 <= x_i <= 1000 for x_i in operations if t_i == 1)
preconditions.description: For type 1 operations, x_i must be between -1000 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(-1000 <= k_i <= 1000 for k_i in operations if t_i == 2)
preconditions.description: For type 2 operations, k_i must be between -1000 and 1000.
The sequence must always contain at least one element.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n lines, one for each operation.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(output[i] - expected_average[i]) <= 1e-6 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output average must be within an absolute or relative error of 10^-6 from the expected average.
